plans.idea: Keep the original's structure but use the wide format: logo above a left-aligned text column that runs across about 60% of the width, so the headline sets on one large line with the subhead under it, and the bottle fills the full height on the right with no dead band on the left.

A banner that reads left to right in three columns: the logo is centred vertically in its own left column, the headline and subhead sit in a wide centre column, and the bottle stands full height on the right, so the eye moves from brand to message to product.

Product-first mirror: the bottle anchors the left edge at full height, and a combined block of logo, headline and subhead is left-aligned on one shared edge to its right, filling the long remaining width with balanced copy.
